title: Show Hope marks 10,000 adoptions across 65 countries, surpassing its founders' original goal
summary_full: Show Hope, the non-profit organization founded by Steven Curtis Chapman and Mary Beth in 2003, has achieved significant milestones. The charity has successfully helped over 10,000 children find permanent families through its adoption grants. In celebration of this achievement, a benefit concert will be held at the Grand Ole Opry featuring notable artists. Five dollars from each ticket sold will support the organization's ongoing programs.
